definition.title: MSE future-range replacement [report paragraph label]
definition.source_excerpt: R119: after appending the red→blue source, the future [2,4] range was removed and an independent green clip was appended at offset 2. The same SourceBuffer then showed red at 1.5 s and green at 2.5/3.5 s. This demonstrates bounded in-place future replacement without reconstructing the MediaSource.
